_note: Which earlier tax years' retirement deductions form the B of RET-GRATUITY-AGGREGATE's A − B: every gratuity entry — S2 s.19(2)(a), "B = the aggregate amount of gratuity or gratuities which was or were received in any one or more earlier tax years and allowed as an exemption or a deduction" (quoted in RET-GRATUITY-AGGREGATE's note), which names no entry of s.19(1) Table, so government (Sl. 3), defence (Sl. 4), statutory (Sl. 5) and other (Sl. 6) gratuity all count (owner's reading, D-339 C3a). TY 2025-26: 1961 s.10(10)(iii) provisos, "to the same effect" as that note records. Reached by the payment's entry (retirement.entry, the entry the aggregate caps) and each earlier entry the ledger holds (retirement.earlier.entry). The row states the reach only; provisions, introduction and provenance are RET-GRATUITY-AGGREGATE's (W-155c1). Every regime.
